messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing-metering anomaly detected. High number of overage flags emitted for prod-east between 12:00-12:06 UTC. Suspected delayed usage emission causing late/duplicate counts. Paging rotation: @alex please take. Incident: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-1234

alex: on it, looking at metering pipeline + reconciler.

tara: grabbing emit-service logs now. running `kubectl logs -l app=emit-service -n prod --since=15m | grep emit_batch --context=2`

tara: logs show repeated `emit_batch` entries for same request_id ranges around 12:01:
```
2024-06-07T12:01:03Z emit_batch request_id=abc123 shard=7 status=emitted
2024-06-07T12:01:04Z emit_batch request_id=abc123 shard=7 status=emitted (retry)
2024-06-07T12:01:05Z emit_batch request_id=def456 shard=3 status=emitted
```

alex: that looks like duplicate emits. ingestion lag is fine but the emit-worker is reprocessing some batches. suspect consumer rebalance / partitioner change from today's deploy at 11:58.

billing-eng: confirmed: some customers (acct_42, acct_77) received overage flags. we should pause notifications asap.

emily: pausing billing notifications now -> `POST /ops/pause?service=notify-billing` -> 200 OK. will hold until reconcilation completes. :white_check_mark:

jon: can we rollback the kafka consumer partitioner change? that was merged in the 11:58 deploy.

alex: starting a canary rollback to image tag `v2.14.2` for emit-service. will monitor consumer offsets.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by @alex.

tara: starting dedupe/reconcile job: `python tools/dedupe_counts.py --window 10m --target prod --workers 8` (running without dry-run). posting progress in thread.

billing-eng: agree we need to run backfill reconciliation and emit compensating adjustments before unpausing notifications. I'll prepare the adjust script.

emily: drafting support notes for affected customers, saving as ticket draft: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-1234-draft (will not send until we confirm corrected counts).

jon: creating temporary dashboard widgets for `token_count_delta`, `emit_rate`, `duplicate_emits` and silencing the noisy overage alerts.

alex: rollback complete. consumer rebalances stabilized. duplicate_emits metric down ~95% within 2m of rollback. reconcile job currently processing ~1.2M events, ETA ~18m.

emily: notifications remain paused. coordinating comms + legal for wording.

billing-eng: running a reconcile dry-run for acct_42 now, posting sample before/after counts.

alex: quick root-cause summary:  partitioner change in today's deploy caused overlapping emit windows during consumer rebalance -> duplicate emits to metering -> late overage flagging. Mitigations taken: rollback partitioner change, run dedupe/reconcile backfill, paused notifications, drafted customer comms. Next actions: postmortem + stricter deploy gating for consumer partition changes, automated duplicate-detection at emit time.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Created postmortem ticket INC-1234-PM and timeline recording. :memo:

emily: thanks all. will coordinate customer comms once reconcile finishes. :thumbsup:
